explanation: The signed March 20, 2026 renewal, effective April 1, 2026 through March 31, 2027, sets QFL's discount at 10% (list $1,920, net $1,728), so it applies on May 1, 2026. The April 9 debrief saying it 'stays at 12%' conflicts with the signed contract, and the signed document takes precedence.
